rationale: SLICE iteration 1 (replaces the round-2 plan). Profiles from config/printer.json: stock MK3S printer, 0.20mm QUALITY @MK3, Prusament PETG (filament_type PETG = print_requirements). Its 240 then 250 °C, bed 85 then 90 °C and 30-50 % part fan sit inside the requirements' 230-250 / 80-90 °C and the skill's PETG guidance, so they are not overridden. library/materials.csv and lessons.md are empty: no flow, temperature or xy_size_compensation overrides. Overrides meet print_requirements.json exactly: 4 perimeters, 5 top / 5 bottom layers, 50 % gyroid, 0.2 mm layers, elephant-foot compensation 0.2 (min; keeps the bore's first layer from narrowing, brief). Checked in the G-code: beyond r 12.4 (the teeth) there is only perimeter, no infill. Orientation is in the STL (brief): outer disc face on the bed, hub up; no supports (mesh_check: no overhangs or bridges). Seam: aligned. Checked in the G-code: on the disc every outline loop starts in a tooth root (start radius 11.7 on all 70 disc-layer loops), off the tooth flanks and tips; on the Ø10 hub it sits on the free outer face. The running bore (Ø3.5 printed on the M3 bolt, 0.5 mm clearance) carries its own small seam. Brim: none (brim_width 0): 515 mm² of disc face on the bed holds a 20 mm part, and a brim would leave flash on the tooth tips. 2 copies on 1 plate = spec §7 quantity 2; sliced 1.16 h against the 2 h limit.
